beats.headline: One dose a day
beats.text: Reading the entry on the spider that swallowed Samantha, Carl finds two level-15 spells, Unending Insanity and the blindness spell Lights Out, neither of which can be cured without divine intervention. Mordecai has prepared for this. His potion is called Liquid Therapy: taken once a day, it protects until the drinker sleeps, against both spells and a host of other fear-based debuffs and afflictions. The ingredients are expensive, but he makes enough for the whole guild, and Carl has spent both his table upgrade coupons on Mordecai's alchemy table. Carl and Donut have taken theirs; Mongo's is not ready yet.
